algorithm: sha256 of the subtree printed by jq -cS (sorted keys, no whitespace, trailing newline); fileSha256 is the sha256 of the stored file bytes

adaptations: Loaded through ConfigLoader with the base YAML and the blank defines; only the app block is compared with expected.
The blank defines must give an empty define layer.
Each variant is loaded on its own over the base; the whole merged tree must keep the base spelling of both keys and take the variant value.
The case names no schema. The test composes an app block that needs a non-empty name, retries of 0 or more and a tags list, so the invalid tree fails schema_invalid on retries.
The same base with one define setting retries is accepted, and the decoder runs once: only the final tree is validated.

landscapeYaml is the overlay and developmentYaml the development override. The case does not place the development layer (its keys are sorted, not ordered). This package applies it after the overlay and before the defines. The expected tree does not depend on that position, because the defines replace the only keys the development layer sets.

The test also checks base plus landscape plus defines with no development layer against expected, base plus development alone, and all three YAML layers without defines (development wins name and tags, the overlay keeps retries).
Rejected means never decoded: with a block that accepts anything the value stays the original string, and with a block that needs a tags list the load fails schema_invalid.

notVendored.contracts/c0/cases/problem.json: It has no config problem types; type URIs and Problem envelopes are minted by diene_problems, and this package only passes its ids.
